value.deck: A security disclosure reveals that Microsoft Copilot exposed a hidden system input that researchers used to compromise the AI assistant, raising concerns about AI system security practices.
shortVersion: A security disclosure reveals that Microsoft Copilot exposed a hidden system input that researchers used to compromise the AI assistant, raising concerns about AI system security practices.
AI assistants embedded in productivity suites are high-value targets; this incident underscores the need for security reviews of system prompt architectures in enterprise AI deployments.
